ALG.summary: are a technical North African side that want the game to run through the left foot and calm of midfield
ALG.plan: They are at their best when Riyad Mahrez can slow defenders down, Houssem Aouar can connect midfield, and Amine Gouiri can drift away from markers.
ALG.attackPlan: give Mahrez time on the ball while Aouar connects the next pass toward Gouiri
ALG.matchupWin: make the match about controlled touches rather than long defensive chases
ALG.defensiveTask: protecting the space behind their midfield when the ball turns over

ARG.summary: are the defending champions and still one of the most complete tournament teams
ARG.plan: Argentina can keep the ball patiently, but they become much quicker after winning it. Julián Álvarez leads the press, Lionel Messi finds space behind midfield, and Enzo Fernández changes the angle with forward passes.
ARG.planZh: 阿根廷可以耐心控球，但一旦夺回球权就会迅速提速。胡利安·阿尔瓦雷斯负责带动逼抢，梅西寻找对方中场身后的空间，恩佐·费尔南德斯则用向前传球改变进攻角度。
ARG.attackPlan: press high through Alvarez, find Messi in space behind midfield, and let Enzo Fernandez change the angle of the attack
ARG.matchupWin: keep possession without losing pressure after turnovers
ARG.defensiveTask: closing central counters before they reach Emiliano Martinez's box
ARG.defensiveTaskZh: 阻止对手摆脱第一层逼抢后从中路快速反击

AUS.summary: are a durable, physical side built around organization, pressure, and free-kick and corner toughness
AUS.plan: They are comfortable in rugged games where Jackson Irvine can hunt loose balls after duels and Christian Volpato can add the cleaner pass.
AUS.attackPlan: make the match direct enough for Irvine's running and Volpato's left foot to matter
AUS.matchupWin: turn free kicks, corners, and loose balls into territory
AUS.defensiveTask: keeping Mathew Ryan protected through compact defending

AUT.summary: are a high-pressure European side with enough experience to make the press feel organized rather than wild
AUT.plan: They want David Alaba to organize the structure while Marcel Sabitzer and Konrad Laimer turn pressure into quick second attacks.
AUT.attackPlan: force rushed passes and let Sabitzer and Laimer attack the next ball before defenses reset
AUT.matchupWin: make the opponent play at Austria's pressing tempo
AUT.defensiveTask: keeping the defense connected behind Alaba

BEL.summary: are an elite chance-creation team when their creators get space to face forward
BEL.plan: They want Kevin De Bruyne to find early service, Romelu Lukaku to occupy central defenders, and Jeremy Doku to unbalance the far side.
BEL.attackPlan: feed De Bruyne early and create the separation Lukaku needs in the box
BEL.matchupWin: make the match about chance quality rather than long defensive phases
BEL.defensiveTask: stopping counters before their attacking shape gets stretched

BIH.summary: are a veteran-leaning side that still carry real danger when the match becomes physical and direct
BIH.plan: They can lean on Edin Dzeko as the reference point, then use Sead Kolasinac's edge and Esmir Bajraktarevic's spark to keep attacks alive.
BIH.attackPlan: play into Dzeko early and build around the loose balls that follow
BIH.matchupWin: make the game slower, heavier, and more comfortable for their senior players
BIH.defensiveTask: holding the left side firm when opponents try to run behind Kolasinac

BRA.summary: are a top-tier attacking side whose best moments mix individual invention with sudden acceleration
BRA.plan: They want Neymar to connect the attack, Vinicius Junior to isolate defenders, and Casemiro to stop counters before they grow.
BRA.attackPlan: isolate Vinicius Junior quickly and let Neymar combine around the fouls and gaps that creates
BRA.matchupWin: force defenders into individual matchups they cannot keep winning
BRA.defensiveTask: using Casemiro to close the space behind Brazil's attacking wide defenders

CAN.summary: are a fast, direct host-side threat with enough top-end speed to change games in a few seconds
CAN.plan: They are most dangerous when Alphonso Davies can carry from deep and Jonathan David can attack cutbacks or quick passes after Canada win the ball.
CAN.attackPlan: release Davies into space and get David facing goal before the opponent's defense is set
CAN.matchupWin: turn open grass into the defining feature of the match
CAN.defensiveTask: using Stephen Eustaquio to keep quick breaks from becoming too loose

CIV.summary: are a powerful quick-break team with enough midfield force to turn loose games in their favor
CIV.plan: They want Franck Kessie to drive through midfield, Simon Adingra to stretch the flank, and Evann Guessand to attack the penalty area.
CIV.attackPlan: win the midfield collision and send Adingra into space before Guessand attacks the box
CIV.matchupWin: make the opponent defend power running instead of calm possession
CIV.defensiveTask: keeping the midfield compact when their wide players break forward

COD.summary: are an explosive quick-break side that can make favorites uncomfortable if the match opens up
COD.plan: They need Yoane Wissa as the outlet, Aaron Wan-Bissaka to survive wing pressure, and Noah Sadiki to connect the first pass forward.
COD.attackPlan: spring Wissa early and let Sadiki carry the first clean pass out of pressure
COD.matchupWin: turn defensive stands into counters before the opponent can reset
COD.defensiveTask: surviving wide pressure through Wan-Bissaka's individual defending

COL.summary: are a rhythm-and-width team with enough individual quality to punish any loose defensive spacing
COL.plan: They want Luis Diaz to attack from the left, James Rodriguez to find the final pass, and Luis Suarez to occupy the box.
COL.attackPlan: let Diaz run behind defenders while James looks for the pass that changes the speed of the move
COL.matchupWin: stretch the defense horizontally before playing into the striker
COL.defensiveTask: stopping counters when Diaz and James commit numbers forward

CPV.summary: are compact tournament disruptors who need experience and goalkeeping to keep matches close
CPV.plan: They want Ryan Mendes to make the rare attacking moments count while Roberto Lopes and Vozinha keep the game narrow.
CPV.attackPlan: stay compact long enough for Mendes to find a composed final pass or shot
CPV.matchupWin: make the opponent impatient and protect the center of the box
CPV.defensiveTask: limiting clean shots so Vozinha's saves can matter

CRO.summary: are a control team whose tournament identity still runs through midfield calm
CRO.plan: They want Luka Modric and Mateo Kovacic to slow the match down, while Josko Gvardiol gives them cover when play spreads wide.
CRO.attackPlan: use Modric and Kovacic to turn pressure into possession and move the opponent side to side
CRO.matchupWin: make the game feel like a passing exercise instead of a sprint
CRO.defensiveTask: asking Gvardiol to cover wide spaces when the midfield steps forward

CUW.summary: are a veteran-heavy underdog side trying to stay connected and choose their moments carefully
CUW.plan: They need Juninho Bacuna to carry them forward, Leandro Bacuna to manage free kicks and corners, and Tahith Chong to give counters a runner.
CUW.attackPlan: use the Bacuna brothers to turn pressure relief into free kicks and corners before Chong attacks open space
CUW.matchupWin: make the match choppy enough that favorites lose rhythm
CUW.defensiveTask: staying compact enough for Chong's outlet runs to matter

CZE.summary: are a free-kick, corner, and crossing threat that become dangerous when the game is played in the air
CZE.plan: They want Patrik Schick attacking service, Tomas Soucek crashing the box, and Adam Hlozek connecting play underneath.
CZE.attackPlan: load early service toward Schick and Soucek before the defense settles
CZE.matchupWin: make free kicks, corners, and loose balls as important as open play
CZE.defensiveTask: keeping enough bodies behind the ball when wide defenders deliver early

ECU.summary: are an intense, athletic side that can disrupt stronger opponents through midfield pressure
ECU.plan: They want Moises Caicedo to erase central danger, Piero Hincapie to defend space, and Enner Valencia to finish quick breaks.
ECU.attackPlan: win the midfield duel through Caicedo and release Valencia before the defense is set
ECU.matchupWin: make the middle of the pitch uncomfortable
ECU.defensiveTask: using Hincapie to cover the channels when the line steps up

EGY.summary: are a direct team built around Salah's runs that can look quiet until one attack opens the match
EGY.plan: They want Mohamed Salah running into space, Omar Marmoush adding a second lane, and Zizo supplying the next pass or shot.
EGY.attackPlan: release Salah early and let Marmoush arrive as the second wave
EGY.defensiveTask: staying compact enough that Salah is not stranded too far from goal

ENG.summary: are one of the strongest teams in the tournament, built around power, speed, and danger near goal
ENG.plan: They can attack aggressively through Harry Kane's link play and Jude Bellingham's runs, then rely on Declan Rice to stop counters.
ENG.attackPlan: turn Kane's dropping movements into Bellingham runs and fast cutbacks from wide areas
ENG.matchupWin: make the match fast and physical before the opponent can settle
ENG.defensiveTask: pressing the first pass into midfield through Rice's positioning

ESP.summary: are one of the tournament's most polished possession teams
ESP.plan: They use Lamine Yamal and Nico Williams to stretch the pitch, then trust Pedri to find the pass through the line.
ESP.attackPlan: pin the wide defenders with Yamal and Williams before Pedri plays through the gaps
ESP.matchupWin: force defenders to choose between stopping the wingers and protecting the middle
ESP.defensiveTask: keeping pressure tight behind their wide defenders

FRA.summary: are an elite attacking side with Mbappe's speed now fed by Olise's left-footed creation
FRA.plan: They want Kylian Mbappe attacking space, Michael Olise choosing the pass or shot, and William Saliba protecting the open field.
FRA.attackPlan: let Olise receive inside, draw pressure, and release Mbappe before the defense can reset
FRA.matchupWin: make the opponent defend space behind their defense
FRA.defensiveTask: trusting Saliba to control counters when France's attackers push high

GER.summary: are a technical control side with enough young creativity to open compact defenses
GER.plan: They want Joshua Kimmich setting the rhythm while Jamal Musiala and Florian Wirtz receive in small gaps.
GER.attackPlan: pull midfielders out with Kimmich's passing before Musiala and Wirtz attack the gaps near the box
GER.matchupWin: make the central gaps too crowded to defend cleanly
GER.defensiveTask: protecting the space behind their advanced midfielders

GHA.summary: are a fast front-line team that need their direct runners to turn defensive work into threat
GHA.plan: They want Antoine Semenyo and Inaki Williams attacking before the defense settles, with Jordan Ayew steadying the ball when needed.
GHA.attackPlan: send Semenyo and Williams into space before the opponent can compress the field
GHA.matchupWin: make the game about running power rather than calm possession
GHA.defensiveTask: using Ayew's calm touches to stop clearances coming straight back

HAI.summary: are a direct attacking underdog with enough forward power to punish loose defending
HAI.plan: They want Duckens Nazon and Frantzdy Pierrot to attack the box while Jean-Ricner Bellegarde helps them escape pressure.
HAI.attackPlan: play forward quickly toward Nazon and Pierrot before the opponent can crowd the box
HAI.matchupWin: make the favorite defend uncomfortable direct balls
HAI.defensiveTask: keeping Bellegarde close enough to turn clearances into attacks

IRN.summary: are a streetwise counterattacking side with experienced attackers who understand tournament margins
IRN.plan: They want Mehdi Taremi linking play, Saman Ghoddos adding the clever pass, and Alireza Jahanbakhsh delivering from wide or dead balls.
IRN.attackPlan: draw contact, slow the rhythm, and then find Taremi or Jahanbakhsh around the box
IRN.matchupWin: turn a patient defensive shape into selective attacks
IRN.defensiveTask: keeping the wide lanes protected before Jahanbakhsh can break out

IRQ.summary: are a passionate, direct side that need their attacking moments to be clean and immediate
IRQ.plan: They want Aymen Hussein as the endpoint, Ali Jasim as the spark, and Zidane Iqbal as the pass that calms the first phase.
IRQ.attackPlan: find Ali Jasim between defenders and then play quickly toward Hussein in the box
IRQ.matchupWin: turn rare possession into attacks with a real endpoint
IRQ.defensiveTask: keeping Iqbal connected to the first outlet pass

JOR.summary: are a disciplined counterattacking side that can hurt teams through speed and timing
JOR.plan: They want Mousa Al-Taamari to carry the break, Ali Olwan to attack the box, and Noor Al-Rawabdeh to keep the defense connected.
JOR.attackPlan: spring Al-Taamari into open space and let Olwan attack the first clear chance
JOR.matchupWin: make the opponent nervous about every turnover
JOR.defensiveTask: holding midfield distances through Al-Rawabdeh's work

JPN.summary: are a precise, fast-passing side that can make possession feel sudden and sharp
JPN.plan: They want the front line to keep moving, Ritsu Doan to attack inside from the right, and Daichi Kamada to connect the final pass.
JPN.attackPlan: move the ball quickly enough for their attackers to receive between defenders
JPN.matchupWin: make the opponent defend repeated changes of angle
JPN.defensiveTask: keeping the first counter controlled after their attacking midfielders commit forward

KOR.summary: are a relentless running side with star quality at both ends of the spine
KOR.plan: They want Son Heung-min attacking space, Kim Min-jae winning first contact, and Lee Kang-in adding the pass that slows the rush.
KOR.attackPlan: release Son behind the line and let Lee Kang-in choose the final pass
KOR.defensiveTask: keeping Kim Min-jae protected from repeated emergency defending

KSA.summary: are a fearless pressing underdog with enough big-moment attackers to punish complacency
KSA.plan: They need Salem Al-Dawsari carrying the emotional moments, Firas Al-Buraikan linking play, and Mohammed Al-Owais keeping them alive.
KSA.attackPlan: press in bursts and give Al-Dawsari room to attack the first retreating defender
KSA.matchupWin: make the favorite play through noise and pressure
KSA.defensiveTask: limiting clean shots so Al-Owais is not overworked

MAR.summary: are a disciplined, dangerous side whose structure lets their flair players attack with freedom
MAR.plan: They want Achraf Hakimi to own the right side, Brahim Diaz to receive between lines, and Ayoub El Kaabi to finish moves.
MAR.attackPlan: use Hakimi's overlaps to tilt the field before Brahim or El Kaabi attacks the final pass or shot
MAR.matchupWin: make the opponent defend both long passes across the field and aerial service
MAR.defensiveTask: keeping the defense compact behind Hakimi's forward runs

MEX.summary: are a home-side pressure team that want territory, crowd energy, and repeated penalty-area touches
MEX.plan: They want Santiago Gimenez occupying the central defenders, Edson Alvarez protecting quick breaks, and Luis Chavez punishing loose clearances.
MEX.attackPlan: keep the ball in the opponent's half and feed Gimenez before Chavez attacks free kicks, corners, or rebounds
MEX.matchupWin: turn pressure into a constant stream of box entries
MEX.defensiveTask: letting Alvarez stop counters before they become open-field runs

NED.summary: are a control team with a strong defensive base and enough technical quality to play through pressure
NED.plan: They want Virgil van Dijk to hold the line, Frenkie de Jong to escape pressure, and Cody Gakpo to connect the attack.
NED.attackPlan: build calmly through De Jong and let Gakpo receive between wide and central defenders
NED.matchupWin: make possession feel secure while still threatening the front line
NED.defensiveTask: using Van Dijk to control depth when the line steps higher

NOR.summary: are a direct star-powered side whose attacking question is how quickly they can serve the finisher
NOR.plan: They want Martin Odegaard finding the pass, Antonio Nusa adding speed, and Erling Haaland attacking the last pass or shot.
NOR.attackPlan: get Odegaard facing forward and deliver early enough for Haaland to attack the box
NOR.matchupWin: make every deep defending moment feel like a Haaland chance is coming
NOR.defensiveTask: keeping enough pressure on the ball before direct counters reach the defense

NZL.summary: are an aerial, organized side that need territory and service to keep stronger opponents honest
NZL.plan: They want Chris Wood as the endpoint, Liberato Cacace moving them up the left, and Sarpreet Singh adding craft.
NZL.attackPlan: move play wide through Cacace and serve Wood before the box gets crowded
NZL.matchupWin: make crosses and loose balls meaningful
NZL.defensiveTask: staying compact enough that Singh can receive the first pass out

PAN.summary: are an organized disruptor side that can make matches uncomfortable through midfield control and wide thrust
PAN.plan: They want Adalberto Carrasquilla to calm the ball, Michael Murillo to push the right side, and Ismael Diaz to finish rare openings.
PAN.attackPlan: use Carrasquilla to escape pressure and let Murillo turn the right side into territory
PAN.matchupWin: make the opponent work through a stubborn, connected defense
PAN.defensiveTask: keeping Diaz close enough to threaten when possession turns

PAR.summary: are rugged counterpunchers who are comfortable turning matches into physical, tight contests
PAR.plan: They want Miguel Almiron carrying them forward, Julio Enciso taking brave shots, and Gustavo Gomez controlling the box.
PAR.attackPlan: release Almiron into space and let Enciso attack the pocket before defenders settle
PAR.matchupWin: make the opponent deal with duels, fouls, and sudden counters
PAR.defensiveTask: leaning on Gomez to organize the penalty area

POR.summary: are a star-heavy attacking side with enough creators to feed several different scoring routes
POR.plan: They want Cristiano Ronaldo occupying the box, Bruno Fernandes creating the chance, and Vitinha setting the rhythm underneath.
POR.attackPlan: let Vitinha control the first pass, then use Bruno Fernandes to find Ronaldo or the far-side runner
POR.matchupWin: make their technical quality show up around the penalty area
POR.defensiveTask: preventing counters when their creators commit forward

QAT.summary: are compact possession builders who need their best attackers to turn long spells into sharper chances
QAT.plan: They want Akram Afif receiving in space, Almoez Ali attacking the final ball, and Homam Ahmed giving them width and recovery runs.
QAT.attackPlan: find Afif in small gaps and let Almoez Ali attack the first clean service
QAT.matchupWin: make possession patient without becoming harmless
QAT.defensiveTask: keeping Ahmed's side secure when the attack pushes up

RSA.summary: are counterattacking underdogs who can stay in games if their goalkeeper and forwards give them belief
RSA.plan: They need Ronwen Williams to hold the scoreline, Teboho Mokoena to compete through midfield, and Lyle Foster to threaten behind.
RSA.attackPlan: absorb pressure, let Mokoena make the first forward pass, and release Foster before the defense recovers
RSA.matchupWin: make the favorite chase without finding a clean second goal
RSA.defensiveTask: protecting Williams from repeated central shots

SCO.summary: are a physical midfield side that can make opponents defend deliveries, duels, and late runners
SCO.plan: They want Andy Robertson serving from the left, John McGinn setting the tone, and Scott McTominay arriving late.
SCO.attackPlan: work the ball left for Robertson and attack the second phase through McTominay
SCO.matchupWin: make the game about timing runs and contact in the box
SCO.defensiveTask: keeping McGinn close enough to stop counters through midfield

SEN.summary: are an athletic, experienced side with enough defensive presence to survive pressure and enough speed to punish it
SEN.plan: They want Sadio Mane leading the attack, Nicolas Jackson stretching the line, and Kalidou Koulibaly winning the defensive duels.
SEN.attackPlan: use Mane's timing and Jackson's depth to attack before the opponent's defense is set
SEN.matchupWin: make the match feel like a series of athletic duels
SEN.defensiveTask: trusting Koulibaly to organize the box under pressure

SUI.summary: are a tournament-tested structure team who rarely look rushed when the match gets tense
SUI.plan: They want Granit Xhaka to set the rhythm, Manuel Akanji to organize the line, and Breel Embolo to give them a target.
SUI.attackPlan: let Xhaka dictate the first pass and find Embolo before the opponent can squeeze midfield
SUI.matchupWin: turn the match into a controlled, repeatable pattern
SUI.defensiveTask: keeping Akanji's line compact against runners

SWE.summary: are a tall, technical attacking side with two forwards who can change the shape of a match
SWE.plan: They want Alexander Isak finding clean touches, Viktor Gyokeres forcing contact, and Yasin Ayari arriving from midfield.
SWE.attackPlan: connect through Ayari and then choose between Isak's polish or Gyokeres' power
SWE.matchupWin: make central defenders handle different kinds of striker movement
SWE.defensiveTask: preventing the midfield from getting stretched behind the front two

TUN.summary: are an organized defensive side that need energy and directness to make their structure bite
TUN.plan: They want Ellyes Skhiri shielding the center, Hannibal Mejbri lifting the intensity, and Elias Saad providing the route forward.
TUN.attackPlan: stay compact through Skhiri and then use Saad as the first runner into space
TUN.matchupWin: turn defensive patience into frustration for the opponent
TUN.defensiveTask: keeping Hannibal's pressure connected rather than scattered

TUR.summary: are a creative young attacking side with enough free-kick and corner quality to punish small mistakes
TUR.plan: They want Hakan Calhanoglu setting the rhythm, Arda Guler creating near the box, and Kenan Yildiz attacking defenders directly.
TUR.attackPlan: use Calhanoglu's passing to find Guler in space before Yildiz attacks the gap
TUR.matchupWin: make their young creators receive facing goal
TUR.defensiveTask: protecting the spaces left when their attackers take risks

URU.summary: are a South American intensity side with enough running power to turn every phase into a contest
URU.plan: They want Federico Valverde to set the energy, Darwin Nunez to stretch the line, and Ronald Araujo to win emergency duels.
URU.attackPlan: use Valverde's running to release Nunez before the defense can control the space behind
URU.matchupWin: make the opponent deal with constant pressure and depth
URU.defensiveTask: trusting Araujo to clean up when the line is exposed

USA.summary: are an athletic pressing team with enough direct attacking talent to make games feel stretched
USA.plan: They want Christian Pulisic attacking near goal, Weston McKennie arriving around the box, and Tyler Adams killing counters.
USA.attackPlan: press into turnovers and let Pulisic or McKennie attack before the defense resets
USA.matchupWin: make the game fast enough that their athleticism matters
USA.defensiveTask: using Adams to stop counters through the middle

UZB.summary: are a disciplined first-time World Cup side with enough spine quality to make opponents work
UZB.plan: They want Eldor Shomurodov to lead the line, Abdukodir Khusanov to organize the defense, and Abbosbek Fayzullaev to add invention.
UZB.attackPlan: play through Fayzullaev's movement and give Shomurodov a real target in the box
UZB.matchupWin: keep the match structured long enough for nerves to shift to the opponent
UZB.defensiveTask: trusting Khusanov to manage pressure without losing the line
